title: 第21章 就你了孩子他爹第22章 这个二爷不正经
slug: 凡人修仙捡个仙子做老婆
content_zh:
回到洞府。
周元围绕着地髓石，陆续挖出了十四个深坑，把十四株地元参从充满草木精气的锦盒里取出来。四株二百年的放到地髓石周围，其他的依次向外散开。
“灵秀山种着上千种，数以万计的灵药，地脉之气和草木精气很分散，地元参沉淀百年药效需要十年左右，我这里只种这么点地元参，地脉之气随便吸收，生长速度应该还会更快。”周元期待起了这些地元参的成长速度。
如果能缩短到三五年，以后就可以通过地元参来赚取灵石了。
“开始修炼了。”
周元拿起千年级地元参，服下一滴灵液后，聚敛心神，吞炼起了天地灵气。
这里是灵宗，洞府又完全封闭，不用再担心被妖兽袭击，被散修打扰，他可以心无旁骛的修炼。这也是很多散修，期望加入灵宗的原因之一。
“咦，好像炼化速度更快了。”
周元刚炼化完一缕雷灵之气，发现速度竟然比森林里快了许多。看来之前那不是千年级地元参的极限，而是林子里的灵气稀薄，而这里灵气浓郁，炼化速度自然就更快了。
夜深，苏珂坐在洞府里，纤指有一搭没一搭的拨弄着案上香盏。炉烟袅袅，在她低垂的睫羽前缭绕，红润的唇角，悄然勾起一丝淡淡的笑意。
她能想象到周元那个懵懂小子，此刻在洞里坐立不安，浮想联翩的样子。
一个无父无母的山野少年，费尽心思攒够灵石，孤身穿越千里险恶山林，怀揣着七分忐忑三分希冀，来到灵宗赌一丝渺茫仙缘，或许已经做好被拒绝的准备，也或许做好跪地哭求的打算，却偏巧遇到了好心的师姐。
不仅接纳他入了宗门，还言语温柔，主动照拂，甚至在不经意间流露出了些许亲近之意。
哪个少年不怀春？
何况还是她这般千娇百媚的。
这种情况下，男人的智商会降到最低，不会想到自己何德何能，只会兴奋自己有魅力。就像那个周庭。
周元那小子现在恐怕正在给自己鼓劲，要不要深夜来拜访了。
“咚咚……”
石门响起了小心的敲击声。
盏中香灰轻轻一塌，苏珂笑意渐深，果然还是来了。

小家伙挺勇敢嘛。
也会挑时候。
三更半夜敲师姐的门。
苏珂很好地掩盖好戏弄的笑意，却似不经意的扯动长袍，领口微露，那抹动人的白皙，随着妖娆步态，微微摇颤，这娇媚之态足以让任何怀春少年血脉喷张。
虽然她只是要找个遮掩，不会动感情，但是这样挑逗少年的感觉，还挺好玩儿。
苏珂来到洞口，敞开禁制，推开了石门。
月色如练，潺潺浸着山林。
树影在夜风中轻摇，四下幽寂无声。
一道精壮的身躯刻意挺得笔直，手中紧紧攥着一卷灵诀。见石门缓缓敞开，他深吸一口气，刚欲挤出笑容说明来意，却在对上洞内那道身影的瞬间，呼吸骤然凝滞。
美。
太美了。
倾城的容颜，白嫩的肌肤，若隐若现的丰腴……嘶……
丑！
太丑了！
苏珂看着门外杵着的男子，只觉一阵反胃。并不是她想象里稚嫩的小青蛙，而是一只黑丑黑丑的癞蛤蟆。
“苏……苏师姐……我……我这里有点……不太懂……”周庭已经想好了说辞，可看着面前千娇百媚，还微微露白的苏珂，只觉嘴巴都不利索了。
“周师弟，我这段时间太累了，改天吧。”苏珂裹紧衣袍，甚至都不想再陪这个周庭演戏，顺手关上石门。
“师姐好好休息，我改天再来。”
周庭看着紧闭的石门，深深提了口气，压住突然窜起来的邪火。苏珂很明显是在等人，既然不是他，很可能就是周元了。
果然啊，师姐对周元的兴致更高。

幸好他提前出手，让周元退出了。
他，还有机会！
周元盘坐在洞府里，心神沉静，默默吞炼着雷灵之气。
之前十天的逃窜乱战，让他对雷噬和雷刹的掌控已经达到了期望的程度，不需要再花时间演练，他现在要的是境界。
饿了就吃米团。
content_en:
Return to the cave.
Zhou Yuan dug fourteen deep pits around the earth marrow stone, and took out fourteen earth ginseng plants from the brocade box filled with plant essence. Four two-hundred-year-old plants were placed around the earth marrow stone, and the others spread out in turn.
"Lingxiu Mountain is home to thousands of kinds of elixirs, tens of thousands of them. The energy of the earth veins and the essence of plants and trees are very scattered. It takes about ten years for the earth ginseng to accumulate a century-old medicinal effect. I only grow this small amount of earth ginseng here. If the energy of the earth veins is absorbed casually, the growth rate should be even faster." Zhou Yuan is looking forward to the growth rate of these earth ginseng.
If it can be shortened to three to five years, you can earn spiritual stones through Diyuan Ginseng in the future.
"Start practicing."
Zhou Yuan picked up the thousand-year-old Earth Essence Ginseng, drank a drop of spiritual liquid, gathered his mind, and swallowed the spiritual energy of heaven and earth.
This was the Ling Sect, and the cave was completely closed. He no longer had to worry about being attacked by monsters or disturbed by wandering cultivators. He could practice without any distractions. This is also one of the reasons why many casual cultivators hope to join the Ling Sect.
"Hey, it seems that the refining speed is faster."
Zhou Yuan had just finished refining a ray of thunder spirit energy and found that the speed was much faster than in the forest. It seems that it was not the limit of thousand-year-old Earth Essence Ginseng before, but the spiritual energy in the forest was thin, and the spiritual energy here is rich, so the refining speed is naturally faster.
Late at night, Su Ke was sitting in the cave, fiddling with the incense stick on the table. The smoke from the furnace curled up in front of her lowered eyelashes, and the corners of her red lips quietly evoked a faint smile.
She could imagine that ignorant boy Zhou Yuan, sitting restlessly in the cave at this moment, thinking wildly.
A young man with no father or mother in the mountains tried his best to save enough spiritual stones, traveled alone through thousands of miles of dangerous mountains and forests, and came to the Lingzong to gamble on a slim chance of immortality. He might have been prepared to be rejected, or he might have planned to kneel down and cry, but he happened to meet a kind-hearted senior sister.
Not only did he accept him into the sect, but he also spoke gently, took the initiative to look after him, and even showed some intimacy inadvertently.
What young man is not pregnant with spring?
What's more, she is so charming and charming.
In this case, a man's IQ will be reduced to the lowest level, and he will not think about his virtues or abilities, but will only be excited about his charm. Just like that Zhou Ting.
That boy Zhou Yuan is probably encouraging himself to come to visit late at night.
"Dong dong..."
There was a careful knock on the stone door.
The incense ash in the cup collapsed slightly, Su Ke's smile gradually deepened, and sure enough, it came.
The little guy is quite brave.
I also choose the time.
Knocking on senior sister's door in the middle of the night.
Su Ke concealed his teasing smile very well, but he seemed to inadvertently pull on his robe, revealing the collar, and his charming white skin, trembling slightly with his enchanting gait, this charming attitude is enough to make any Huaichun boy's blood boil.
Although she just wanted to find a cover and would not be emotional, it was quite fun to tease the boy like this.
Su Ke came to the entrance of the cave, opened the restriction, and pushed open the stone door.
The moonlight is like a prairie, soaking in the mountains and forests.
The shadows of the trees swayed gently in the night wind, and everything was silent.
A strong body deliberately stood straight, holding a volume of spiritual secrets tightly in his hand. Seeing the stone door slowly opening, he took a deep breath and was about to smile to explain his purpose, but when he faced the figure in the cave, his breath suddenly froze.
beautiful.
So beautiful.
Alluring face, white and tender skin, looming plumpness...hiss...
Ugly!
So ugly!
Su Ke looked at the man standing outside the door and felt nauseated. It was not the childish little frog she had imagined, but a black and ugly toad.
"Su...Senior Sister Su...I...I don't quite understand..." Zhou Ting had already thought of his words, but looking at the charming and slightly pale Su Ke in front of him, he felt like he was speechless.
"Junior brother Zhou, I'm too tired during this period. Let's wait another day." Su Ke wrapped up his clothes tightly.He didn't even want to act with Zhou Ting anymore, so he closed the stone door.
"Sister, have a good rest. I'll come back another day."
Zhou Ting looked at the closed stone door, took a deep breath, and suppressed the sudden evil fire. Su Ke was obviously waiting for someone. Since it wasn't him, it was probably Zhou Yuan.
Sure enough, senior sister was more interested in Zhou Yuan.
Fortunately, he took action in advance and allowed Zhou Yuan to withdraw.
He still has a chance!
Zhou Yuan sat cross-legged in the cave, with a calm mind, silently swallowing the thunder spirit energy.
The previous ten days of fleeing and fighting had allowed him to control Thunder Bite and Thunder Sha to the extent he expected. There was no need to spend time practicing anymore. What he wanted now was the realm.
When you are hungry, eat rice balls.
